rule: Complement: every normal recording (no annotated error) that is in neither dev.json nor test.json. Not evaluated. Recordings with at least one annotated error are split by recipe. dev: 2 error recordings per recipe, plus a third in the 12 recipes with the most error recordings (60), and 1 normal recording per recipe (24); the draw, with a fixed seed, was repeated until dev had at least 30 recordings with an Order Error and 30 with a Missing Step. test: all remaining error recordings (160) and 2 normal recordings per recipe (48). reserve_normal: the remaining normal recordings (92), not evaluated.
